Thanks Luca — quick note: when you say "Thursday 10/08 10:00" can you confirm the timezone? Our team has Karthik joining from Amsterdam (CEST) and Ben on the west coast (PDT). Because of the recent DST shifts in Europe, 10:00 CET vs CEST is still tripping up calendar defaults.

To avoid back-and-forth, here are recommended windows that should catch both EU and APAC participants without forcing anyone to wake up in the middle of the night:
- Option A (preferred): Thu 2026-10-08 15:00 CEST / 09:00 EDT / 00:30 IST (short overlap; APAC on call for first 30m)
- Option B (asynchronous-friendly): Thu 2026-10-08 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST — we record the session and schedule a 30m APAC sync the next day

Ben & Karthik — any hard constraints on those windows? I attached a short agenda draft (Q3-demo-agenda.pdf) and a small .ics that includes both timezone labels (calendar-timezones.ics).

If Luca/Priya can confirm preferred option, I’ll send a final invite.

Best,
